content.introduction: The sources indicate a "moderately bullish" outlook for stocks next week, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite on track for weekly gains, supported by AI-related stocks despite rising global bond yields. European equities are also seen as potentially supported by global growth and improving fundamentals. However, the outlook could be challenged if Treasury yields continue to hit new highs. Specific stock changes include significant gains in TER, HPE, SPCX, ON, LW, MPWR, and TSLA, while losses are noted in NVDA, SNDK, AMD, WDC, ACN, EPAM, CTVA, ALNY, and APP.

Stocks grind sideways as October hike odds rise, Treasury auctions clear at multi-year high yields, labor data shows early tightening signs, and bitcoin breaks key levels. 

 September 25, 2026 

Image 8

## Weekly Trader's Outlook

 The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite are on track for weekly gains, assisted by relative strength in AI-related stocks, and despite the march higher in global bond yields. 

 September 25, 2026 

Image 9: Schwab Market Update [...] Fed policymakers unanimously voted to raise rates 25 basis points, the first hike since 2023, and vowed to fight inflation. Another hike is seen this year, but 2027 is in question. 

 September 16, 2026 

Image 14

## European Stocks: Reasons to Reconsider

 European equities may have support from global growth, improving fundamentals, lower relative valuations, and fiscal spending—plus diversification from the AI cycle. 

 September 14, 2026 

Image 15
